nodes.label: ML-DSA-65 Module-Lattice Digital Signature Algorithm
nodes.description: NIST FIPS 204 Category 3 post-quantum digital signature algorithm parameter set offering AES-192 security level based on Module Learning With Errors (M-LWE) and Module Short Integer Solution (M-SIS) hardness.

nodes.label: NVMe over Fabrics (NVMe-oF) with RoCEv2 Transport Layer
nodes.description: Storage interconnect transport protocol encapsulating NVMe commands over RDMA over Converged Ethernet Version 2 (RoCEv2) for low-latency disaggregated memory and block access.

nodes.label: CAMeL Tools Sentiment Analysis Classifier Subsystem
nodes.description: Polarity classification engine within CAMeL Tools evaluating sentiment orientations (positive, negative, neutral) across Modern Standard and Dialectal Arabic texts.

nodes.label: W3C N-Quads RDF Dataset Syntax Standard Specification
nodes.description: W3C Recommendation specifying a line-based, plain-text format for encoding RDF datasets containing subject, predicate, object, and optional graph label quads.

nodes.label: GraphBLAS Louvain Community Detection Modularization Algorithm
nodes.description: Parallel graph clustering algorithm implemented via GraphBLAS sparse matrix-matrix operations optimizing modularity metrics across large-scale graph topology states.
